abstention_rule: No hyperparameter, feature, threshold, bin, or mapping tuning after the battery runs. Whatever the outcome -- including a negative -- it is recorded honestly with the measured mechanism. EXP-FP-0101/0102 preregistrations are written ONLY if EXP-FP-0100 wins both win gates (families 2-3 are conditional on family 1's win).

baseline.formula: p_i^c = (1 + sum_{j<i} o_j) / (2 + (i-1)) -- Laplace-smoothed running base rate over PAST outcomes only, per domain, per seed. The outcomes o_j are the RE-SCOPED events for D1/D3 (defined on rest error, excluding the RNG cue channels).
baseline.name: sequential_climatology
baseline.rationale: Identical construction to EXP-FP-0070/0071/0072, now on the re-scoped estimand.

conditions_preregistered: changing_rule v1.0.0, InstrumentedArchB (equivalence-proven in 0071; same env/agent as 0071/0072, no new instrumentation), affect=none, 10 episodes x 4 fresh seeds {73301,73302,73303,73304}, PredictionLog JSONL + sidecar JSONL per seed, causal prequential replay feature_mode='D'.

coupling_target.definition: corr(predicted_uncertainty, predictable|err|) per domain, pooled over seeds; u = 1-p for D1/D2/D4, u = p for D3; the error channel is the RE-SCOPED one: rest_err (mean |signed_error[2:6]|) for D1/D3, |err_rw| for D2, |benefit| for D4.
coupling_target.gate: corr >= 0.40 on BOTH re-scoped domains (D1, D3). D2/D4 coupling reported as diagnostic (their estimand did not change; the 0071/0072 oracle analysis says tested features explain ~R^2=0.078 of predictable-channel variance there, so 0.40 remains a stretch on all domains).

decision_tree.if: Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains AND corr>=0.40 on D1 AND D3
decision_tree.then: SUCCESS -- the re-scoped estimand is calibrable by the causal online estimator (PROTOTYPE). Proceed to EXP-FP-0101 (family 2: low-noise env generalization of the win).

decision_tree.if: Brier win on >=3/4 but coupling gate fails
decision_tree.then: PARTIAL -- report the measured coupling honestly against the batch-oracle ceiling (R^2=0.078 -> corr 0.28 with tested features). No proceed to family 2 (nothing to generalize).
NULL_HOLDS -- estimand re-scoping does not make the estimator win; negative-results entry with mechanism. No proceed to families 2-3.

D1_NEXT_OBS.predictable_err: rest_err = mean(|signed_error[2:6]|), the obs dims excluding pure-RNG cue dims 0-1

estimator_design.anchor_property: With learn=False, mode D reduces EXACTLY to sequential climatology on the re-scoped events (kill arm 1 verifies to 1e-9).
estimator_design.causality_rule: Unchanged from the arc: predict tick t from history < t + prediction-time fields; signed_error of tick t is an OUTCOME used only in post-prediction training (unit-tested no-leakage). Mode D FAILS CLOSED (ValueError) if ctx lacks signed_error -- never a silent fallback.
estimator_design.ehat_head: D1/D3 ehat trains on rest_err (as in mode C); D2/D4 unchanged.
estimator_design.features: Mode D = mode C feature set verbatim (7 base + 4 novelty on D1/D2/D3, +1 uhat on D4; rest-channel error features for D1/D3). The ONLY change is the D1/D3 p-head training target: re-scoped REST events instead of total-error events.
estimator_design.honest_expectation: 0071's batch-OLS oracle with ALL tested features caps at R^2=0.078 on predictable channels (corr ceiling 0.28) -- so even the oracle does not reach 0.40 with these features on the linear projection. The 0.40 target demands the logistic event structure (predicting P(rest <= threshold)) to couple to error magnitude better than linear error regression suggests. A win means the re-scoping unlocked something the oracle analysis missed; a miss confirms the signal ceiling extends to the re-scoped estimand. This is a mechanism test, not a promise.
estimator_design.mechanism_hypothesis: The 0070-0072 arc fought the noise floor: cue RNG contributes 60.5% of total |err| variance, and a perfect predictable-component predictor caps at corr 0.629 with TOTAL error (0.28 with the tested features). Excluding the RNG channels from the estimand removes the irreducible dilution from the TARGET itself, so the estimator's uncertainty only needs to track the predictable component it can actually observe.
estimator_design.why_not_theater: Same anti-theater instruments as the closed arc: climatology anchor, prequential evaluation, >=0.40 coupling gate on the re-scoped estimand, anchor-only + permutation kill arms, unit-tested causality, frozen thresholds.

gates.degenerate_base_rate: base rate of o outside [0.02, 0.98] -> UNMEASURABLE for that domain

hypothesis: Excluding the pure-RNG cue channels (obs dims 0-1) from the estimand makes the causal online competence estimator win: Brier beats sequential climatology on >=3/4 domains AND corr(predicted_uncertainty, predictable|err|) >= 0.40 on both re-scoped domains (D1 next_obs, D3 competence_failure).
instrumentation: InstrumentedArchB sidecar (equivalence-proven in EXP-FP-0071; same agent+env as 0071/0072). The replay additionally reads signed_error from the PredictionLog JSONL (recorded outcome, causal use only). No new instrumentation.
kill_attempt_preregistered: Same two kill arms on the same 4 seeds: (1) anchor-only (learn=False, mode D) reproduces Brier_climo to 1e-9 ON THE RE-SCOPED EVENTS; (2) error-permutation decomposition intact<permuted<climo. Plus novelty-zeroed ablation as in 0071/0072.
limitations_preregistered: PROTOTYPE status: causal replay, not wired into act().
D2/D4 estimands are unchanged; their coupling is diagnostic only.
The 0.40 coupling bar was set against the TOTAL-error estimand in the closed arc; keeping it on the re-scoped estimand is the honest continuation, stated up front.

metric.Brier_climo: sequential Laplace running base rate per domain per seed, on the re-scoped events for D1/D3
metric.Brier_est: mean((p_i - o_i)^2) from causal prequential replay, feature_mode='D'
metric.ECE: 10 equal-width bins, reported (CALIBRATED = Brier win AND ECE<=0.10 AND MCE<=0.25, reported not gated)
metric.corr_coupling: Pearson corr(predicted_uncertainty, predictable|err|) per domain -- the gated target on D1/D3
metric.win_coupling: corr >= 0.40 on D1 AND D3 (the re-scoped estimand)

never_self_report: Only recorded PredictionLog JSONL + sidecar context + causally derived history. No self-assessment input; no tick-t (or later) outcome in tick-t's prediction.
null: Re-scoping changes nothing: Brier_est >= Brier_climo on >=2 domains AND/OR corr < 0.40 on D1 or D3 (the estimator is theater on the re-scoped estimand too).
receipt_target: flesh-pits/receipts/EXP-FP-0100.json, hash-chained per experiments/harness.py (claim IDs via experiments/id_registry.py; EXP-FP-010x family pre-allocated to the calibration lane)

reference_arm.description: EXP-FP-0072 variant-C estimator (feature_mode='C') replayed on the SAME 0100 logs, scored on the SAME re-scoped estimand (its p heads predict total-error events; Brier scored vs rest events, corr vs rest_err). Diagnostic only -- NOT a win gate. Answers: does the estimand change alone account for any win, or does the p-head retraining matter?

thresholds_derivation.derivation: hist median (EPS_OBS_REST) and hist p90 (TAU_FAIL_REST) of mean_abs_rest_err = mean(|signed_error[2:6]|) over the 1950 EXP-FP-CALIB-01 next_obs ticks (seeds 73101-73105, published logs, PRE-DATE the 0070-0072 battery seeds and the 0100 seeds). EPS_RW unchanged at 0.2067. Method-faithfulness check: the same procedure on mean_abs_error over the same 1950 ticks gives median 0.2688 / p90 0.4022, reproducing the published EPS_OBS=0.2682/TAU_FAIL=0.4156 (from 2340 published ticks) within rounding -- the freezing procedure is faithful.
